title: Proteomics is converging on human and mouse: datasets naming neither fell from 46% to 33%
sub:
PRIDE datasets 2013–2025 (n = 36,249; 8 list no species). Species from PRIDE species metadata, strains collapsed to the binomial;
a dataset naming several species (2,931) counts once for each, so shares do not sum to 100%. Title and b: 2013–16 (n = 2,726) vs 2023–25
(n = 15,565). Within the 354 contributor groups depositing in both periods, the neither-share also fell, 40% (34–46) → 32% (27–38).
Shading and bars: 95% CI, group bootstrap. Dataset counts rose for every species shown; only their shares fell.
